workResult: Applied Skill 04 to exactly three same-date source-complete Reading Notes and produced three bounded Research Objects. Q-20260916-01 concludes that consequential digital-employee completion should be represented as an evidence vector rather than a single success bit: semantic correctness, required-action closure, timeliness, priority/fairness obligations and episode/effect closure can fail independently, and every mandatory dimension must be proven or remain explicitly unresolved before business completion is accepted. Q-20260916-02 concludes that a behavior-relevant deployment transform creates a new evidence subject: lineage to a validated ancestor provides provenance, but active deployment admission should bind the exact output artifact hash, exact transform identity and post-transform validation evidence. Q-20260916-03 concludes that skill routing is an attributable runtime selection plane: it may select which exact skill versions enter context, but selection correctness must remain separate from call-time execution authorization and downstream outcome/acceptance evidence. All three objects are ReadyForProduction with production_input_authorized=true and publication_authorized=false. No article drafting, candidate staging, image generation, Production, Academic or Publication was performed.
